findings.body: The generated conventions use `.env` for local secrets (`src/forge/templates/conventions/security.md:30`), but the scaffold has no `.dockerignore`. With `COPY . .`, a client running `docker build .` while `.env` exists copies those secrets into the image; Git ignore rules do not exclude files from Docker's build context. Add a scaffold Docker exclusion for local secrets or copy only the files the build needs.
findings.title: Exclude local secrets from the Docker image

findings.body: The test waits for `/health` to return 200 and only then checks that the migration created `Ready`. It never checks that health is unavailable while a migration is pending, so starting the server during migration could pass these assertions while violating the readiness contract. It also fetches `/` with urllib instead of testing the frontend in Playwright, as required for client app flows. Hold a migration pending and verify health remains unavailable, then verify the loaded frontend in a browser.
